page.title: 過去の物語は細部も過去色

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、過去の旅行記・会議記録・業務報告などで、主な出来事だけでなく、その理由、背景、相対節、能力・知覚などの付属情報も同じ過去の物語枠に入れる考え方を扱う。現在も事実であり得る性質でも、過去場面の描写として語るなら過去形が自然になることを理解する。
grammarPoints: 過去の物語枠では主節と背景説明の時制をそろえること
because節の理由も過去場面の一部なら過去形になること
関係節の説明も過去の物語に組み込まれると過去形が自然なこと
過去時点の能力・知覚にはcouldを使えること
現在も真実かどうかと物語上の時制選択は別問題であること
過去叙述中の不用意な現在形へのドリフトを避けること
visualEvidence: 主出来事とbecause・関係節・couldの説明が同じPAST STORY FRAME内に置かれている
背景情報も青い過去色で塗られる図がある
NOW STILL TRUE?とNARRATIVE TIME FRAMEが別の問いとして示されている
関係節の動詞も主節と同じ過去枠へ入る矢印がある
ミニ問題で過去の旅行記にgaveを選ばせている
commonTraps: 現在も真実だからと過去物語内の説明だけ現在形にする
because節だけ現在形へ戻して時制を混在させる
関係節の現在形が現時点の断定だと気づかず物語から浮かせる
過去の物語だから全てを過去完了にする
現在の事実と過去の視点を混同する

questions.prompt: During last week's site visit, we chose the smaller conference room because it ------- quieter.

choices.A: was
choices.B: is
choices.D: will be

questions.translationJa: 先週の現地訪問では、その会議室の方が静かだったので小さい方を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: last week's site visitという過去の物語枠の理由説明なのでwasが自然です。

questions.prompt: The team followed a corridor that ------- directly to the loading area.

choices.A: leads
choices.B: led
choices.D: will lead

questions.translationJa: チームは荷積みエリアへ直接つながっていた通路を進みました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のfollowedに組み込まれた関係節の背景描写なのでledが適切です。

questions.prompt: From the observation deck, visitors ------- see the entire warehouse complex.

choices.A: can
choices.B: will
choices.D: have been able to

questions.translationJa: 展望デッキから、来訪者は倉庫施設全体を見ることができました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去場面での能力・知覚可能性を表すためcouldを使います。

questions.prompt: The hotel stood beside a bridge that ------- the river near the station.

choices.A: crosses
choices.B: has crossed
choices.D: crossed

questions.translationJa: そのホテルは駅近くで川を渡る橋のそばに建っていました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の情景描写の一部なので、関係節もcrossedで過去枠に合わせます。

questions.prompt: We canceled the outdoor briefing because the wind ------- too strong for the display boards.

choices.A: was
choices.B: is
choices.D: would be now

questions.translationJa: 掲示板を出すには風が強すぎたので、屋外説明会を中止しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のcanceledの理由を説明するためwasが自然です。

questions.prompt: The client inspected a prototype that ------- less power than the previous model.

choices.A: uses
choices.B: used
choices.D: has used now

questions.translationJa: 顧客は旧モデルより消費電力が少なかった試作品を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のinspection場面に含まれる試作品の特徴としてusedを使います。現在も同じ特性かどうかとは別です。

questions.prompt: At the trade show, we met several suppliers who ------- components for medical devices.

choices.A: make
choices.B: have made
choices.D: will make

questions.translationJa: 展示会で、医療機器向け部品を製造していた複数の供給会社と会いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の展示会という物語枠で紹介しているためmadeが自然です。

questions.prompt: The guide explained that the old factory ------- near the canal and employed more than 300 workers.

choices.A: stands
choices.B: has stood
choices.D: stood

questions.translationJa: 案内係は、その古い工場が運河の近くにあり、300人以上を雇っていたと説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 歴史的な過去の背景を連続して述べるためstoodが適切です。

questions.prompt: When we entered the archive, the lights were dim, but we still ------- read the labels.

choices.A: could
choices.B: can
choices.D: will be able to

questions.translationJa: 資料室に入った時、照明は暗かったものの、ラベルは読むことができました。
questions.explanationJa: その過去場面での可能性なのでcouldが適切です。
questions.focus: 過去場面の知覚可能性

questions.prompt: The manager selected the vendor because its support team ------- available around the clock at that time.

choices.A: is
choices.B: has been
choices.D: will be

questions.translationJa: 当時その会社のサポートチームが24時間対応だったため、部長はその業者を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: at that timeが過去の判断時点を示すためwasが唯一自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that keeps the background detail inside the past narrative frame.

choices.A: We visited a branch that was close to the airport.
choices.B: We visited a branch that is close to the airport yesterday.
choices.C: We visited a branch that has close to the airport.
choices.D: We visit a branch that was close to the airport yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは空港に近かった支店を訪れました。
questions.explanationJa: visitedとその背景説明wasを同じ過去枠に入れたAが自然です。
questions.focus: 主節と関係節の過去枠

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly describes a past reason.

choices.A: We postponed the inspection because the equipment is unavailable that morning.
choices.B: We postponed the inspection because the equipment was unavailable that morning.
choices.C: We postponed the inspection because the equipment has unavailable.
choices.D: We postpone the inspection because the equipment was unavailable that morning.

questions.translationJa: その朝、設備が使用できなかったため、点検を延期しました。
questions.explanationJa: that morningという過去の理由なのでwasが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses ability at a past moment.

choices.A: From our seats, we can hear the speaker clearly during yesterday's session.
choices.B: From our seats, we have hear the speaker clearly yesterday.
choices.C: From our seats, we could hear the speaker clearly during yesterday's session.
choices.D: From our seats, we will hear the speaker clearly yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 昨日のセッションでは、席から講演者の声をはっきり聞くことができました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterday's sessionという過去時点の能力・知覚にはcouldが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with consistent tense in a past travel report.

choices.A: The bus stopped at a town that has a large market yesterday.
choices.B: The bus stops at a town that had a large market yesterday.
choices.C: The bus had stopped at a town that has a large market yesterday.
choices.D: The bus stopped at a town that had a large market.

questions.translationJa: バスは大きな市場があった町に停車しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の旅行報告の中で主節と背景説明をstopped／hadでそろえています。
questions.focus: 過去旅行記の時制統一

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that does not unnecessarily switch to the present tense.

choices.A: We stayed at a hotel whose lobby overlooked the harbor.
choices.B: We stayed at a hotel whose lobby overlooks the harbor last night.
choices.C: We stayed at a hotel whose lobby has overlooking the harbor.
choices.D: We stay at a hotel whose lobby overlooked the harbor last night.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは港を見渡せるロビーのあるホテルに泊まりました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の滞在場面を説明しているのでoverlookedが自然です。
questions.focus: 現在形へのドリフト回避

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly describes a past setting and a past action.

choices.A: The office was small, but it contains two meeting rooms during our visit.
choices.B: The office is small, but it contained two meeting rooms during our visit.
choices.C: The office was small, but it contained two meeting rooms during our visit.
choices.D: The office had small, but it contained two meeting rooms.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが訪問した時、その事務所は小さかったものの会議室が2室ありました。
questions.explanationJa: during our visitの過去枠内なのでwasとcontainedがそろいます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly describes what visitors could do at that time.

choices.A: Visitors could borrow headsets during the 2025 exhibition.
choices.B: Visitors can borrow headsets during the 2025 exhibition yesterday.
choices.C: Visitors had can borrow headsets during the exhibition.
choices.D: Visitors could borrowed headsets during the exhibition.

questions.translationJa: 2025年の展示会では、来場者はヘッドセットを借りることができました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去時点の可能な行為はcould＋動詞原形borrowで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a natural past relative clause in a meeting record.

choices.A: We discussed a proposal that reduces costs during last Monday's meeting.
choices.B: We discussed a proposal that reduced costs during last Monday's meeting.
choices.C: We discussed a proposal that had reduce costs last Monday.
choices.D: We discuss a proposal that reduced costs last Monday.

questions.translationJa: 先週月曜の会議で、コストを削減する提案について議論しました。
questions.explanationJa: last Monday's meetingという過去の議論場面に組み込むためreducedが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that keeps a historical description in the past frame.

choices.A: The museum displayed machines that are used in the 1920s.
choices.B: The museum displayed machines that have used in the 1920s.
choices.C: The museum displayed machines that were used in the 1920s.
choices.D: The museum displays machines that were used during our visit yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 博物館には1920年代に使われていた機械が展示されていました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の歴史的使用を表すためwere usedが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly reports a past choice and its reason.

choices.A: The buyer chose the local supplier because delivery was faster then.
choices.B: The buyer chose the local supplier because delivery is faster then.
choices.C: The buyer chooses the local supplier because delivery was faster then.
choices.D: The buyer chose the local supplier because delivery has faster then.

questions.translationJa: 当時は配送がより速かったため、担当者は地元の供給会社を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: thenが過去の選択時点を明示しているためwasが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "During the tour, the guide showed us a room that was used for training."

choices.A: The room is necessarily no longer used for training.
choices.B: The guide showed us a training room during the past tour.
choices.C: The guide will show us a room used for training.
choices.D: The room could not be used for training during the tour.

questions.translationJa: 見学中、案内係は研修に使われていた部屋を見せてくれました。
questions.explanationJa: was usedは過去の見学場面での説明であり、現在の用途まで否定しません。Bが意味を最も保ちます。
questions.focus: 過去形は現在の否定ではない

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We selected the café because it was quiet."

choices.A: The café's quietness was the reason for our past choice.
choices.B: The café is permanently quiet now.
choices.C: We selected the café after it became noisy.
choices.D: We could not decide whether the café was quiet.

questions.translationJa: そのカフェが静かだったことが、私たちが選んだ理由でした。
questions.explanationJa: because it was quietは過去の選択理由を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "From the balcony, we could see the station."

choices.A: We are able to see the station every day.
choices.B: We had to see the station from the balcony.
choices.C: It was possible for us to see the station from the balcony then.
choices.D: We would see the station only in the future.

questions.translationJa: その時、バルコニーから駅を見ることができました。
questions.explanationJa: could seeは過去時点の知覚可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We stayed in a district that had many small restaurants."

choices.A: The district no longer has restaurants.
choices.B: We will stay in a district with many restaurants.
choices.C: The district must have had no restaurants before.
choices.D: The district had many small restaurants in the setting of our past stay.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが泊まった当時、その地区には小さなレストランが多くありました。
questions.explanationJa: hadは過去の滞在場面の背景説明です。現在の状態は断定していません。
questions.focus: 過去背景と現在事実の区別

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The team used a route that avoided the construction area."

choices.A: The route's function in that past trip was to bypass the construction area.
choices.B: The route can never pass through construction now.
choices.C: The team avoided using any route.
choices.D: The construction area was created after the trip.

questions.translationJa: そのチームは工事区域を避けるルートを利用しました。
questions.explanationJa: avoidedは過去の移動場面でそのルートを説明しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The hall was crowded, but we could still hear the announcement."

choices.A: The hall is crowded now, so hearing is impossible.
choices.B: Despite the crowd, hearing the announcement was possible then.
choices.C: We had already heard the announcement before entering.
choices.D: The announcement will be audible later.

questions.translationJa: 会場は混雑していましたが、それでも案内放送を聞くことはできました。
questions.explanationJa: could still hearは過去の状況下でも聞くことが可能だったという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The buyer chose a supplier that offered overnight support."

choices.A: The supplier stopped all support immediately.
choices.B: The buyer had no supplier choices.
choices.C: Overnight support was a characteristic considered in the past choice.
choices.D: Overnight support will begin after the purchase.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は夜間サポートを提供していた供給会社を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: offeredは過去の選択場面で考慮された特徴を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The building stood on a street that connected the station and the port."

choices.A: The street's connection is explicitly said to have ended.
choices.B: The building was moving along the street.
choices.C: The station and port were not connected then.
choices.D: The past description places the building on a street linking the two locations.

questions.translationJa: その建物は、駅と港を結ぶ通り沿いにありました。
questions.explanationJa: stood／connectedは過去の情景を一貫して描写しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We moved the meeting because the original room was too small."

choices.A: The room's size caused the meeting location to change.
choices.B: The room is definitely still too small today.
choices.D: The room became larger before the meeting.

questions.translationJa: 元の部屋が狭すぎたため、会議場所を変更しました。
questions.explanationJa: was too smallは過去の変更理由です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "At the time, staff could access the system from home."

choices.A: Staff must access the system from home now.
choices.B: Remote access was available to staff then.
choices.C: Remote access had never been available.
choices.D: Staff will gain remote access later.

questions.translationJa: 当時、社員は自宅からシステムにアクセスできました。
questions.explanationJa: could accessはその過去時点で利用可能だったことを示します。

questions.prompt: Yesterday's factory tour was informative. We entered a testing area that ------- several climate chambers.

choices.A: contained
choices.B: contains now only
choices.D: will contain yesterday

questions.translationJa: 昨日の工場見学は有益でした。私たちは複数の恒温槽がある試験エリアに入りました。
questions.explanationJa: 昨日の見学という過去枠に組み込まれた背景説明なのでcontainedが適切です。

questions.prompt: We changed hotels during the business trip. The first one was convenient, but its rooms ------- too noisy at night.

choices.A: are
choices.B: were
choices.D: will be

questions.translationJa: 出張中にホテルを変えました。最初のホテルは便利でしたが、夜は部屋が騒がしすぎました。
questions.explanationJa: business tripの過去場面を説明するためwereが自然です。

questions.prompt: The seminar took place in an auditorium on the top floor. From there, participants ------- see the city skyline.

choices.A: can
choices.B: will
choices.D: have seen now

questions.translationJa: セミナーは最上階の講堂で行われました。そこから参加者は街の景色を見ることができました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のセミナー時点での可能性なのでcouldが適切です。

questions.prompt: Our group stopped at a service center because the vehicle ------- an unusual noise.

choices.A: makes
choices.B: has made
choices.D: was making

questions.translationJa: 車が異常な音を立てていたため、私たちのグループはサービスセンターに立ち寄りました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のstopの理由となっていた進行中の状況なのでwas makingが自然です。

questions.prompt: The sales director visited a store that ------- mainly to business travelers at the time.

choices.A: catered
choices.B: caters
choices.D: will catered

questions.translationJa: 営業部長は当時、主に出張者向けの店舗を訪れました。
questions.explanationJa: at the timeが過去時点を明示するためcateredが適切です。

questions.prompt: The conference venue was farther from the station than expected, but we ------- reach it on foot in about fifteen minutes.

choices.A: can
choices.B: could
choices.D: will be able to yesterday

questions.translationJa: 会議会場は予想より駅から遠かったものの、徒歩約15分で到着できました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の移動場面での可能性を表すためcouldが自然です。
questions.focus: 過去場面の到達可能性

questions.prompt: In the report, Ms. Chen described a neighborhood that ------- several small logistics firms near the port.

choices.A: hosts now
choices.B: has host
choices.D: will hosting

questions.translationJa: 報告書でチェンさんは、港近くに小規模物流会社がいくつもあった地区について説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の報告内容の情景描写としてhostedが自然です。

questions.prompt: We selected the eastern route because traffic ------- lighter there during the morning inspection period.

choices.A: is
choices.B: has been
choices.D: was

questions.translationJa: 朝の点検時間帯はそちらの交通量が少なかったので、東側ルートを選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のselection理由なのでwasが適切です。

questions.prompt: The visiting team entered a laboratory that ------- strict temperature controls during the trial.

choices.A: required
choices.B: requires now therefore
choices.D: will required

questions.translationJa: 訪問チームは、その試験中に厳格な温度管理を必要としていた研究室に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: during the trialという過去枠に属する性質説明なのでrequiredが自然です。

questions.prompt: The old training center had narrow hallways, so large groups ------- move through the building only slowly.

choices.A: can
choices.B: could
choices.D: have to now

questions.translationJa: 旧研修センターは廊下が狭かったため、大人数のグループは建物内をゆっくりしか移動できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の施設条件のもとでの可能性・制約を表すためcouldが適切です。
